---
title: "Microsusceptibility_assay"
output: html_document
---


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Read tidy dataset
df <- read.csv("microsusceptibility_data.csv")

# Optional: Concentrations to keep, ordered low to high
concentration_levels <- c(
  0.046875, 0.09375, 0.1875, 0.375, 0.75,
  1.5, 3, 6, 12, 24
)

# Isolate order
isolate_levels <- c(
  "Pseudomonas sp.",
  "Rahnella sp.",
  "Enterobacter sp.",
  "Flavobacterium sp.",
  "Curtobacterium sp.",
  "Pantoea sp."
)

# Facet labels
bacteria_labs <- c(
  "Pseudomonas sp."    = "italic('Pseudomonas')~'sp.'",
  "Rahnella sp."       = "italic('Rahnella')~'sp.'",
  "Enterobacter sp."   = "italic('Enterobacter')~'sp.'",
  "Flavobacterium sp." = "italic('Flavobacterium')~'sp.'",
  "Curtobacterium sp." = "italic('Curtobacterium')~'sp.'",
  "Pantoea sp."        = "italic('Pantoea')~'sp.'"
)

# Clean and filter data
df_plot <- df %>%
  filter(
    isolate != "ntc",
    concentration %in% concentration_levels
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    isolate = factor(isolate, levels = isolate_levels),
    concentration = factor(concentration, levels = concentration_levels)
  )

# Plot
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = concentration, y = od600, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = treatment),
    width = 0.2,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ isolate,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = as_labeller(bacteria_labs, label_parsed)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    x = "Protein concentration (µM)",
    y = "OD600",
    fill = "Treatment",
    color = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Avenir Next Medium"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )


ggsave("AvrStb6_microsusceptibility_assay.png", width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 600)

```
